newsitem.title: USA: India Fund names new portfolio manager.
newsitem.headline: India Fund names new portfolio manager.

text.p: The India Fund Inc said on Tuesday that Punita Kumar-Sinha would assume responsibility for management of the fund's portfolio effective Aug. 1, 1997.

Kumar-Sinha, who recently joined the fund's investment manager Advantage Advisers, has ten years of academic research and fund management experience involving international and emerging markets, including approximately three years as portfolio manager.
Barclays Global Investors International, which has managed the fund under a subadvisory agreement with Advantage since the fund's inception, will resign effective August 1.
Barclays Group would continue to assist the fund in the future through its various brokerage, research and other capabilities, the fund said.
